petTypes.title: Pet Types
petTypes.noTypes: No pet types in this file.
petTypes.confirmDelete: Delete the custom pet "{{name}}"? This removes its entire pet-config section.
petTypes.complexValue: Complex value — edit via raw YAML.
petTypes.modelHelp: Render this pet with a custom 3D model from a model-provider plugin (ModelEngine, BetterModel, ItemsAdder, or MythicMobs) instead of its vanilla appearance. Leave the provider empty to keep the default look.
petTypes.modelCollision: <0>{{provider}}</0> model "<1>{{id}}</1>" is already used by the pet type "<2>{{other}}</2>". Each custom type needs a unique model — the plugin will otherwise skip one of them on load.
petTypes.nameHeightHelp: Vertical offset for the pet’s name tag above the model.

Food.label: Food (one item per line)
Food.help: Items that tame/feed this pet, e.g. bone.

LeashItem.label: Leash Item
LeashItem.help: Item used to tame, e.g. lead.

LeashRequirements.label: Leash Requirements
LeashRequirements.help: Flags like Tamed, Baby, Owner — one per line.

GrowUpItem.label: Grow-Up Item
GrowUpItem.help: Item that ages a baby up (baby-capable pets).

RetainEquipmentOnTame.label: Retain Equipment On Tame
RetainEquipmentOnTame.help: Keeps the armor and weapons a wild mob was wearing when it is tamed, as real pet equipment that drops on death and release. Off strips the gear and drops it where the mob stood. Equipment-capable pet types only.

AllowMetamorphosis.label: Allow Metamorphosis
AllowMetamorphosis.help: Lets a Tadpole pet mature into a Frog pet after vanilla's 20-minute timer. The pet keeps its name, level, XP and skill state, but permanently becomes a Frog — including losing Tadpole-only skilltrees. Off (the default) freezes the timer so the pet stays a Tadpole.

Brain_Disabled.label: Disabled Brain AI (one per line)
Brain_Disabled.help: Vanilla brain AI to switch off, e.g. activity:fight or behavior:SonicBoom. Clearing this restores vanilla AI — for Piglin Brutes, Piglins, Hoglins and Zoglins that means the pet will attack its owner. Takes effect the next time the pet spawns.

petTypes.animationsNote: MyPet plays each of these by its default name (the label). Override one only if your model names it differently; leave blank to use the default. Walk/idle/run/jump are handled by the model plugin and are not configured here.

petWizard.modelIdManualHelp: No models detected for {{provider}}. Enter a model ID manually.
petWizard.uploadReconnecting: Reconnecting — wait for the session to reconnect before uploading.
petWizard.uploadNeedsSession: Uploading needs a live <0>/mypet editor</0> session — connect one to enable this.
petWizard.uploadExplainer: Uploads to {{provider}}; the model appears for players once {{provider}} regenerates its resource pack and clients re-download it. The file name (without <0>.bbmodel</0>) becomes the model id, so it must match the blueprint id declared inside the model.
petWizard.nameHeightHelp: Vertical offset for the pet’s name tag above the model.
petWizard.modelCollision: <0>{{provider}}</0> model "<1>{{modelId}}</1>" is already used by the pet type "<2>{{other}}</2>". A model is a pet’s identity, so each custom type needs a unique model — pick a different one (the plugin would otherwise skip this type on load).
petWizard.creatureNameHelp: The internal pet-config key for this pet type (e.g. FrostDragon). Must be unique.
petWizard.hostMobHelp: The vanilla Bukkit mob type that provides the base entity for this pet.
petWizard.healthHelp: Base health points for this pet (e.g. 20 = 10 hearts).
petWizard.walkSpeedHelp: Movement speed attribute (e.g. 0.3 is the standard walk speed).
petWizard.foodHelp: Items that feed this pet, e.g. wheat. Leave empty to inherit the host mob’s food.
petWizard.leashHelp: Conditions that must hold for a lead to work on this pet (e.g. Wild, Baby).
petWizard.leashNeedsSession: Leash requirements need a live session.
petWizard.reviewIntro: The following section will be added to <0>pet-config.yml</0>:

avenues.BetterModel: Build a brand-new creature rendered with a BetterModel model. Requires a Java 25 server.
avenues.ModelEngine: Build a brand-new creature rendered with a ModelEngine model.
avenues.ItemsAdder: Build a brand-new creature using an ItemsAdder model.
avenues.MythicMobs: Build a creature from a MythicMob — MyPet spawns the real MythicMob and adopts it; it keeps its model and turns back into the MythicMob on release.

petWizard.nameCharset: Use only letters, numbers, and underscores (no dots or spaces).
petWizard.readFileFailed: Failed to read the selected file.
petWizard.defaultModelNote: Uses one of MyPet's bundled default models — no external model plugin content required.
